_readme: TOP-5 LAUNCH STATE: the five RoDD-board leaders are published in strategies[]. books[]/bundles return later. Trade-level data per slug in _tools/trades/. Full previous catalog archived at _tools/archive/catalog2.goal33-final.json.

_template_strategy._HOW_TO_FILL: Copy one object out of drafts.strategies into strategies[], fill every field, then run the three generators. A product only appears on the site once it is in the published list.
_template_strategy.slug: url-safe-id — becomes /strategies/<slug>.html and the CSS identity hook fc-<slug>. NEVER change a slug once it is live.
_template_strategy.name: the cool display name, e.g. Spartacus
_template_strategy.actual: the real/technical name shown as the subtitle, e.g. MNQ Two-Trend Chassis
_template_strategy.meta: MARKET · session — first token(s) must be the uppercase market code(s) (MNQ/NQ/MGC/SI/ES); they become the market chips
_template_strategy.window: 01 Feb 2026 - 19 Aug 2026 — human-readable headline window, shown under the name

stats.EXAMPLE: the validated figure as a display string, e.g. RoDD '21.75', PF '1.77', Win '67.0%', Net '$27.5k', Max DD '$1.3k', Trades '1,302', $/trade '$21', Months '7', RoDD/mo '3.11'

full.label: Full 2024+ window (context)
full.stats: same nine keys, the wider-window figures

_template_strategy.price: integer dollars/mo. Formula: eff = RoDD x min(1, sqrt(n/300)); price = round10(159 + 12*eff^1.15 - 60) - 1. Books are hand-priced ABOVE the formula.
legs: optional list of leg NAMES for multi-leg books — names only, never settings
sep: one or more 'what separates this strategy' lines; the first also becomes the card blurb
_template_strategy.warn: optional honest warning published as a trust device, e.g. a known bad week. Empty string if none.
_template_strategy._glyph: add a matching SVG mark in _tools/glyphs.py keyed by slug, or the glyph slot renders empty
_template_strategy._identity: for a flagship/book, add an fc-<slug> colour skin in main.css (see the six existing ones) to get the themed product page

strategies.name: Continuum
strategies.meta: MNQ · 24h — every session leg routed through one book
sep: Every validated session leg, routed through one 24-hour book: one product, one subscription, the whole clock.
The #1 strategy on our validation board: 39.20x return on max drawdown across 1,877 trades.

strategies.name: Midas
strategies.meta: MGC · 24h — the gold book: five session legs on one metal
sep: Five gold session legs — overnight structure, London, Tokyo, NY data, FVG continuation — run as one book.
$119.5k best-window net on 1,317 trades at 70.5% wins.
strategies.warn: The full 2024+ record includes the book's development period; the published best window is the current configuration's run.

strategies.name: Aftershock
strategies.meta: MNQ · 08:30 ET — the data-release range fade, Mon/Wed/Fri
sep: Fades the 08:30 economic-data burst back into the pre-release range - the session's most violent minutes, traded with structure.
Runs Monday/Wednesday/Friday only: the days the release schedule concentrates the edge.

strategies.name: Tailwind
strategies.meta: MNQ · day + evening — FVG continuation, two-stage exits
sep: The fair-value-gap continuation rebuilt on the book's own one-minute engine - two-stage exits and a break-even latch on favorable excursion.
$53.2k best-window net across 974 trades at 78.4% wins.
strategies.warn: Same edge family as Slipstream - the two are correlated, not independent, so owning both concentrates exposure rather than diversifying it. Trade counts are exit legs (two per position), and the full record's $9.5k drawdown shows what this edge did outside the 2026 window its current configuration was tuned in.

strategies.name: Relay
strategies.meta: MNQ · 08:30 ET — the range fade, five days a week
sep: Runs the 08:30 range fade every trading day: the Mon/Wed/Fri vector and a separate Tue/Thu vector, combined in one script.
27.85x return on max drawdown across 509 best-window trades.
strategies.warn: Shares its Mon/Wed/Fri vector with Aftershock - running both doubles that exposure rather than diversifying it. The Tue/Thu vector's first independent tape reproduction is this record itself, the configuration was finalized in Aug 2026 inside the record's own window, and one live morning where a touched fade level did not fill (26 Aug 2026) is still under review.

strategies.name: Slipstream
sep: Rides the continuation after a fair-value gap is defended - entering with the imbalance, not against it.
77.1% wins across 878 best-window trades.

strategies.name: Ignition
strategies.meta: NQ · 09:30 ET - the opening range the New York bell prints
sep: Takes the break of the range the New York open prints - the first structure of the session, traded in its direction.
82% wins at 5.44 profit factor: the highest win rate and the highest profit factor on our board's top five.
strategies.warn: Selective by design: the published best window holds 66 trades - a far smaller sample than our high-frequency legs, and the pricing formula discounts it accordingly. Treat it as a low-frequency, high-conviction leg, not a volume engine.

strategies.name: Undertow
strategies.meta: MNQ · overnight — the five-minute level sweep and reclaim
sep: Trades the overnight sweep of a mapped level and the reclaim that follows - entering where stops were just cleared.
73.9% wins across 303 best-window trades.
strategies.warn: The full record's drawdown is a different world from the 2026 window ($6.4k vs $1.5k): the current configuration was re-optimized in Aug 2026 and its strength is concentrated in 2026. Size from the full record, not the best window.

strategies.name: Meridian
strategies.meta: MNQ · 13:00 ET — the early-afternoon confirmed fade
sep: Waits for the 13:00 move to confirm against itself, then fades it - one placement a session, two-stage exits.
82.5% best-window wins at a 2.64 profit factor.
strategies.warn: Trade counts are exit legs - the two-stage exits book two rows per placement, so 348 best-window trades is roughly 174 session placements. The configuration was hand-tuned in Aug 2026 on the same history this record covers.

strategies.name: Closer
strategies.meta: MNQ · 15:30 ET — the late-day fade, flat by 15:55
sep: Fades the midday move in the session's last half hour - one placement at 15:30 ET, everything flat by 15:55.
PF 2.04 across 142 best-window trades, at the second-lowest price on the board.
strategies.warn: Priced near the bottom of the catalog for a reason: the full record nets about $10 per trade at one contract (PF 1.34), stretches of it predate the current configuration, and 2026 - the year the configuration was tuned - runs PF 1.31. The best window is genuine; treat this as a low-cost session leg, not a flagship.

strategies.name: Daybreak
strategies.meta: MNQ · 20:00 ET — the Tokyo open drive
sep: Trades the drive off the 20:00 ET Tokyo open - an evening breakout leg for the hours most subscribers sleep through.
59.4% wins at PF 1.70 across the best window, at the lowest price on the board.
strategies.warn: The cheapest strategy on the board, priced by the same formula as every other: the full record is thin (PF 1.18, about $6 per trade at one contract, 47.9% wins), and the stronger figures live in the recent window shown above. Buy it as a low-cost evening-session leg with its record in plain view - not as a volume engine.
